'''LaGrange''' ({{IPAc-en|l|ə|ˈ|g|r|eɪ|n|dʒ}} {{respell|lə|GRAYNJ}}) is a [[Administrative divisions of New York#Town|town]] in [[Dutchess County, New York|Dutchess County]], [[New York (state)|New York]], United States. The population was 15,975 at the 2020 census.<ref name="Census 2010">{{cite web| url=http://factfinder.census.gov/bkmk/table/1.0/en/DEC/10_SF1/G001/0600000US3602740299| title=Geographic Identifiers: 2010 Demographic Profile Data (G001): La Grange town, Dutchess County, New York| publisher=U.S. Census Bureau, American Factfinder| access-date=November 12, 2015| archive-url=https://archive.today/20200213130932/http://factfinder.census.gov/bkmk/table/1.0/en/DEC/10_SF1/G001/0600000US3602740299| archive-date=February 13, 2020| url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>United States Census Bureau, 2020 Report, LaGrange town, New York</ref>  The town was named after the estate of the [[Marquis de Lafayette]].<ref>{{cite book | url=https://archive.org/details/bub_gb_9V1IAAAAMAAJ | title=The Origin of Certain Place Names in the United States | publisher=[[United States Government Publishing Office|Government Printing Office]] | author=Gannett, Henry | year=1905 | pages=[https://archive.org/details/bub_gb_9V1IAAAAMAAJ/page/n178 179]}}</ref>
